question: In Thor: Love and Thunder, 12 Guardians pairs (drax|groot, drax|peter-quill, drax|rocket, groot|nebula, groot|peter-quill, kraglin|nebula, kraglin|rocket, kraglin|mantis, mantis|rocket, nebula|peter-quill, nebula|rocket, peter-quill|rocket) have no documented one-on-one exchange; the proposed stages rest on them serving together on the same team in the same scenes (Indigarr battle, goat argument on the Benatar, the distress calls, the goodbye to Thor). proposed.text: Bobby fights the Sentinels in Moscow to buy Kitty time, and later dies defending the temple while she keeps Logan's mind in the past.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fights to buy Kitty time in Moscow and at the temple.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Bobby fights to protect.

their_evidence: 2023 Moscow: the mutants sacrifice themselves to buy Kitty time to send Bishop back; at the temple Iceman is killed while Kitty holds Logan in 1973. The Rogue Cut adds that they are dating, not in the theatrical cut.

question: Should The Rogue Cut count as on screen? In it Xavier, Magneto and Bobby rescue Rogue from Cerebro and she takes over holding Logan's mind (he senses her). The theatrical cut gives her a wordless three-second cameo only.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Xavier takes Logan into his school after the X-Men save him and Rogue, and offers to help him uncover his lost past. Logan stays and fights for him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Takes Logan in and offers to help him find his past.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A drifter Xavier takes into his school and turns into an X-Man.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In a future where Sentinels hunt mutants, Xavier asks Logan to travel back to 1973 and guide his younger self. When history changes, Logan wakes to find Xavier alive and his school thriving.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sends Logan back to 1973 to save the future.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The X-Man Xavier sends back in time to change history.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: Logan returns to Xavier's school wanting more about his past. Xavier tells him he must find some answers for himself and leaves him to watch the students.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Tells Logan to find some answers himself.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Back at Xavier's school, left to watch the students.

their_evidence: Fandom plot: Wolverine returns, Xavier shows him Cerebro, says he can't tell him everything and he must find out some things himself; Wolverine is left to babysit the children.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Storm and Cyclops save Logan and Rogue from Sabretooth on a snowy road and bring them to Xavier's school. Logan and Storm fight side by side against the Brotherhood.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Rescues Logan in the snow and fights beside him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Brought to the school by Storm after a rescue.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: After Xavier's death, Storm leads the X-Men, and Logan follows her into the battle at Alcatraz.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Leads the X-Men after Xavier dies, and Logan follows her.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Follows Storm's lead at Alcatraz.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: Storm calls Logan in Boston and flies the X-Jet in to pick him and the students up after the police standoff.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Picks Logan up in the X-Jet in Boston.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Picked up by Storm in Boston.

their_evidence: Fandom plot: Wolverine receives a call from Storm, who decides to come pick them up; the X-Jet arrives after the police standoff. Wikipedia: Storm, Jean and Nightcrawler pick them up in their jet.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Logan lets the runaway Rogue ride with him and promises to look after her. When Magneto uses her to power his machine, Logan saves her by letting her draw on his healing.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The runaway Logan promises to protect and saves at Liberty Island.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rogue's protector, who saves her life with his healing.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: When Rogue thinks about taking the mutant cure, Logan tells her the choice is hers to make.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Thinks about the cure, and Logan tells her the choice is hers.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tells Rogue the cure is her choice.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: Logan gets Rogue out of the school during Stryker's raid and keeps her with him on the run to Boston.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Flees the raid on the school with Logan.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Gets Rogue out of the school during the raid.

their_evidence: Fandom plot: Wolverine, Rogue, Bobby and Pyro escape the raid in Cyclops' car and head to Boston together.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Colossus trains with Logan in the Danger Room, hurling him at a Sentinel, and fights beside him in the battle at Alcatraz.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Logan's teammate, who hurls him into battle.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Colossus's teammate in the Danger Room and at Alcatraz.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: During Stryker's raid on the school, Colossus and Logan round up students and get them to safety.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Helps Logan get students out during the raid.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Rounds up students with Colossus during the raid.

their_evidence: Fandom plot: 'Colossus and Wolverine round up a number of the students' during the military raid. Wikipedia: Colossus leads the remaining students to safety.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Charles saves Erik from drowning as he chases Shaw, and the two become close friends who recruit young mutants together.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Charles's closest friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Erik's closest friend.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Charles and Erik are old friends who long ago took opposite sides over humanity. After the X-Men stop his machine, Charles visits him in his plastic prison to play chess.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's old friend and rival.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Magneto's old friend on the other side.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: The two once visited young Jean together to bring her to the school. Now they race to her family home, where the Phoenix kills Charles and leaves with Erik.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Watches Charles die and leaves with Jean.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The old friend whose death Erik witnesses.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In a future ruled by Sentinels, the old rivals fight side by side and send Logan back to change history.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Charles's old rival, now fighting beside him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fights beside Magneto in a last stand.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: Charles visits Erik in his plastic prison, where Erik admits he told Stryker everything about Cerebro. Later Erik turns Stryker's Cerebro so the captive Charles will kill every human.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Gives Charles's secrets to Stryker, then turns him on humanity.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Used by Magneto to try to kill every human.

their_evidence: Fandom plot: Magneto confesses to Xavier that he told Stryker everything; at Alkali Lake Magneto reconfigures Dark Cerebro and Mystique has Jason make Xavier target humans.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Xavier's voice guides the blinded teenage Scott and the other children freed from Stryker's island to safety, and he welcomes them.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The boy Xavier leads to safety and raises at his school.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rescues Scott and raises him as an X-Man.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: Xavier takes Scott with him to question Magneto, and Stryker's people capture them both at the prison.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Goes with Xavier to see Magneto and is captured with him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Taken captive with Scott at Magneto's prison.

their_evidence: Fandom plot: Cyclops and Professor X visit Magneto in the plastic prison; gas knocks out Xavier and Deathstrike defeats Cyclops; both are captured.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Jean is a doctor and teacher at Xavier's school and one of his X-Men. When Mystique's sabotage of Cerebro leaves him in a coma, Jean uses the machine herself to find Magneto's target.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's student and fellow telepath.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Jean's mentor.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Xavier long held back the dark side of Jean's power with mental blocks. Free of them as the Phoenix, she resents him and tears him apart at her childhood home.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Becomes the Phoenix and destroys Xavier.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The mentor who caged Jean's power, whom she destroys.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: As Jean holds back the flood at Alkali Lake, she speaks her goodbye to the team through Xavier's mind.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Says goodbye to the team through Xavier's mind.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The mentor Jean speaks through as she says goodbye.

their_evidence: Wikipedia plot: 'Jean telepathically says goodbye through Xavier as flames erupt from her body' before the flood crashes down on her.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Ororo is one of Xavier's first X-Men and teaches at his school.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: One of Xavier's first X-Men.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Storm's mentor.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: When the Phoenix kills Xavier, Ororo gives his eulogy and keeps his school open as its new head.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Carries on Xavier's school after his death.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The mentor whose school Storm takes over.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: Storm has Nightcrawler take her into Stryker's Cerebro, where she freezes the room to break Jason's hold and free Xavier.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Freezes Stryker's Cerebro to free Xavier.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Freed by Storm from Stryker's Cerebro.

their_evidence: Fandom plot: Storm persuades Nightcrawler to get inside Cerebro and intensifies the cold, freezing Jason to save Professor X. Wikipedia: Nightcrawler teleports Storm inside Cerebro where she creates a snowstorm to free Xavier.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Xavier takes in Rogue after her power puts a boy in a coma, and the X-Men save her from Magneto's machine.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The runaway Xavier takes in.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Gives Rogue a home.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: Rogue goes with Xavier's X-Men to the White House and hands the President Stryker's files while Xavier warns him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hands the President Stryker's files beside Xavier.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Leads Rogue and the X-Men to the White House.

their_evidence: Fandom plot: at the White House 'Rogue gives him the files from Stryker's private offices while Professor X tells him about the events'. Wikipedia lists Rogue among the X-Men there.
